_note: O Farol, cena 02 'A Última Vigília' (2026-11-11), played once the fight in the lantern room (farol-topo) is won. O Faroleiro is a 'fallen' actor: his body stays where he fell. Only Kael speaks; the lens' last turn is a caption. No walks: wherever the fight left Kael is where he stands.

steps.text: …a lente gira mais uma vez, devagar, e para.

translations.en: …the lens turns once more, slowly, and stops.

steps.text: Acabou a vigília, Anselmo. Pode descansar.

translations.en: The watch is over, Anselmo. You can rest.

steps.text: Sem a luz falsa, os barcos voltam a ver as pedras. E os que subiram da gruta não têm mais quem os chame.

translations.en: Without the false light, the ships can see the rocks again. And the ones who climbed out of the cave have no one left to call them.

steps.text: A pedra que ele pôs na lanterna veio lá de baixo. Se ainda há Ember sob este penhasco, alguém vai vir buscar.

translations.en: The stone he set in the lantern came from below. If there is still Ember under this cliff, someone will come for it.
